items.title: Wall St’s $500 bln pledge to Nvidia yet to be mobilized, WSJ reports
items.summary: Investing.com-- Wall Street’s biggest banks and asset managers had pledged up to $500 billion to help Nvidia customers finance chip purchases earlier this year, but no capital has been deployed to date, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.

items.title: Wall Street Pledged to Mobilize $500 Billion for Nvidia—but Hasn’t Put Up a Dime
items.summary: A wave of money that was supposed to help customers keep buying Nvidia chips hasn’t materialized.
